_about: Batch B6a (mHC residual mixing, decoder layer). Owner: B6a writer.

mhc.short: The residual design of DeepSeek-V4.1. The residual stream is kept as hc_mult parallel streams. Learned mixes combine them before and after each sub-layer.

hc-mult.short: The number of parallel residual streams in mHC. The trunk has the shape [T, hc_mult, H]. The value comes from config.json, not from the repo.
hc-mult.long: Read at {{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/config.py:294}}. The fused mega_mhc path needs hc_mult = 4 ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/hc.py:99-101}}).

sub-layer.short: One of the two parts of a decoder layer: attention or the MoE (FFN). mHC mixes the residual streams before and after each sub-layer.

mhc-trunk.short: The code's name for the mHC residual stream: a bf16 tensor [T, hc_mult, H] that carries hc_mult streams of H values per token from layer to layer. The streams start as copies of the embedding output and then differ.

pre-mix.short: mHC weights [T, hc_mult, 1] that turn the hc_mult streams into one sub-layer input: a weighted sum of the streams, one weight per stream and token.

post-mix.short: mHC weights [T, hc_mult, 1] that say how much of the sub-layer output each stream gets.

comb-mix.short: An mHC matrix [T, hc_mult, hc_mult] per token that mixes the old streams into the new streams. Sinkhorn normalization is applied to it.

sinkhorn-normalization.short: An algorithm that scales the rows and the columns of a positive matrix in turn, until each row and each column sums to about 1.
sinkhorn-normalization.long: DeepInfer applies it to the mHC residual mix with hc_sinkhorn_iters rounds ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/mhc_ops.py:95-99}}).

hc-shifted.short: An mHC mode (hc_shifted) where each sub-layer applies the pre mix that the sub-layer before it computed. The model then ends with one mix, not an HCHead.
hc-shifted.long: {{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/hc.py:64-67}}. The HF loader sets it to True when config.json has no value ({{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/config.py:295}}).

hc-lazy-post-data.short: A small data class that carries the trunk and the mHC mixes from one sub-layer to the next, so that the post mix can run later, together with the next pre mix.

mega-mhc.short: A DeepGEMM call that does the mHC post of one sub-layer, the pre of the next, the RMSNorm and the FP8 cast in one kernel call. GPU only, hc_mult = 4, and H a multiple of 1024.

hc-head.short: The module that mixes the hc_mult streams into one hidden state at the end of the model, when hc_shifted is off.
